text: Los's theorem says the ultraproduct $\prod_{i} \mathcal{M}_i / \mathcal{U}$ satisfies a formula $\phi$ if and only if:
choices: the set $\{i \mid \mathcal{M}_i \models \phi\}$ belongs to the ultrafilter $\mathcal{U}$
explanation: Los's theorem: the ultraproduct models $\phi$ iff $\{i \mid \mathcal{M}_i \models \phi\} \in \mathcal{U}$, i.e. 'almost all' factors as measured by $\mathcal{U}$ satisfy it. Requiring all factors is too strong and requiring one is too weak; a tautology would hold in every structure and misses the ultrafilter's role entirely.
